verificationSummary: Project Control commit 616a1822e9d705a763245d0e726aca632a63d868 records a bounded Core and Backend readiness matrix before Editor/frontend redesign. The matrix reconciles accepted Core, Backend, Editor, compatibility, browser smoke, and terminology evidence; permits architecture planning, adapter boundary design, and focused contract hardening; and records NO-GO for frontend implementation that assumes production Backend readiness. This evidence supports only the pre-frontend readiness decision and next-lane selection; it does not promote FlowDoc, Core, Backend, or Editor truth, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, cross-browser readiness, broad corpus coverage, accessibility, visual regression, performance, bundle-size readiness, or map truth.
